blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein denominator \(x^3 + 1\) pehle se factors mein nahi diya gaya, yahi is ka asal pech hai.
Pehle sum of cubes ka formula lagakar factors banayenge; phir yeh Case III ban jata hai.
Find kya karna hai? Partial fractions, yani constants \(A\), \(B\), \(C\).
Plan: factors, shakal, \(x = -1\) se \(A\), coefficients se \(B\) aur \(C\), aur aakhir mein wapas jor kar tasdeeq.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\frac{x^2 + 1}{x^3 + 1}\).
Humein find karna hai: is ki partial fractions.
Tareeqa: Top ki degree 2 aur bottom ki 3 hai, is liye proper fraction hai. Lekin denominator abhi factors mein nahi likha hua. Pehle sum of cubes (cubes ka jama) wale formula se factors banayenge, phir dekhenge ke quadratic factor toot sakta hai ya nahi. Phir Case III: linear factor ke upar constant aur quadratic ke upar \(Bx + C\).

Denominator ke factors banayein
\[x^3 + 1 = x^3 + 1^3\]
\[= (x + 1)(x^2 - x + 1)\]
Kyun: Partial fractions ke liye denominator ka poora factorised hona zaroori hai. \(x^3 + 1\) cubes ka jama hai, is liye formula \(a^3 + b^3 = (a + b)(a^2 - ab + b^2)\) lagaya, jahan \(a = x\), \(b = 1\). Ab \(x^2 - x + 1\) ka discriminant \(1 - 4 = -3\) negative hai, is liye yeh aage nahi toot sakta.
Dhyan dein: beech wala sign minus hai: \(x^2 - x + 1\), \(x^2 + x + 1\) nahi.

Partial fractions ki shakal likhein
\[\dfrac{x^2 + 1}{(x + 1)(x^2 - x + 1)}\]
\[= \dfrac{A}{x + 1} + \dfrac{Bx + C}{x^2 - x + 1}\]
Kyun: Linear factor \(x + 1\) ke upar constant \(A\), aur irreducible quadratic ke upar \(Bx + C\). Yeh wohi Case III wala qaida hai jo Example 6 mein istemal hua.

Denominators hata kar identity banayein
\[x^2 + 1 = A(x^2 - x + 1)\]
\[+ (Bx + C)(x + 1) \quad \text{(i)}\]
Kyun: Dono taraf \((x + 1)(x^2 - x + 1)\) se multiply kiya. \(A\) ke saath quadratic aur \(Bx + C\) ke saath \(x + 1\) bacha. Ab yeh identity hai, is liye \(x\) ki koi bhi value rakh sakte hain.

\(A\) ke liye (i) mein \(x = -1\) rakhein
\[1 + 1 = A(1 + 1 + 1) + 0\]
\[2 = 3A\]
\[A = \dfrac{2}{3}\]
Kyun: \(x = -1\) se \(x + 1 = 0\) aur \((Bx + C)\) wala term khatam. Quadratic mein \((-1)^2 - (-1) + 1 = 1 + 1 + 1 = 3\) bana.
Dhyan dein: \(-(-1) = +1\); yahan aksar students \(1 - 1 + 1 = 1\) likh kar ghalat \(A\) nikal lete hain.

(i) ki right side kholein
\[A(x^2 - x + 1) = Ax^2 - Ax + A\]
\[(Bx + C)(x + 1)\]
\[= Bx^2 + Bx + Cx + C\]
\[x^2 + 1 = (A + B)x^2\]
\[+ (-A + B + C)x + (A + C)\]
Kyun: Har bracket khol kar \(x^2\), \(x\) aur constant terms alag ikatthe kiye. \(B\) aur \(C\) kisi value rakhne se seedhe nahi milte, is liye coefficients compare karna parta hai.

Coefficients compare karein
\[x^2:\ 1 = A + B\]
\[B = 1 - \dfrac{2}{3} = \dfrac{1}{3}\]
\[\text{const}:\ 1 = A + C\]
\[C = 1 - \dfrac{2}{3} = \dfrac{1}{3}\]
Kyun: Left side \(x^2 + 1\) mein \(x^2\) ka coefficient 1 aur constant bhi 1 hai. Right side ke barabar rakh kar aur \(A = 2/3\) daal kar \(B\) aur \(C\) dono \(1/3\) aaye.

\(x\) ke coefficient se parakh
\[-A + B + C = -\dfrac{2}{3} + \dfrac{1}{3} + \dfrac{1}{3}\]
\[= 0 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Left side mein \(x\) ka term nahi, yani coefficient 0. Hamari values se bhi 0 aaya; yeh azaad parakh batati hai ke constants sahi hain.

Partial fractions likhein
\[\dfrac{A}{x + 1} = \dfrac{2}{3(x + 1)}\]
\[\dfrac{Bx + C}{x^2 - x + 1} = \dfrac{x + 1}{3(x^2 - x + 1)}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{1}{3}x + \frac{1}{3}\) mein \(\frac{1}{3}\) common hai, is liye \(\frac{x + 1}{3}\) likha aur 3 ko denominator mein le gaye. Isi tarah \(\frac{2/3}{x + 1} = \frac{2}{3(x + 1)}\).

Tasdeeq: fractions ko wapas jorein
Common denominator \(3(x + 1)(x^2 - x + 1)\); top:
\[2(x^2 - x + 1) = 2x^2 - 2x + 2\]
\[(x + 1)(x + 1) = x^2 + 2x + 1\]
\[\text{Top} = 3x^2 + 3\]
\[= 3(x^2 + 1) \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Common denominator \(3(x + 1)(x^2 - x + 1) = 3(x^3 + 1)\) liya. Pehle fraction ka top quadratic se, doosre ka \((x + 1)\) se multiply hua. Jorne par \(3(x^2 + 1)\) aaya, aur 3 cancel kar ke asal fraction \(\frac{x^2 + 1}{x^3 + 1}\) wapas mil gaya.
blocks.final_answer:
\(\frac{x^2 + 1}{x^3 + 1} = \frac{2}{3(x + 1)} + \frac{x + 1}{3(x^2 - x + 1)}\)
Yeh book ke jawab se milta hai, lekin key mein yeh "6" ke number par chhapa hai (neeche dekhiye).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki answer key mein yeh jawab "3" ke bajaye "6" ke number par chhapa hai (Exercise 5.2 ki key ke numbers 1, 2, 3, 6, 7, 3 chhape hain). Jawab khud sahi hai: \(\frac{2}{3(x + 1)} + \frac{x + 1}{3(x^2 - x + 1)}\). Key mein "3" wala pehla jawab is sawal ka nahi, us se confuse na hon.
